description: Land Title Settlement Department - Lunuwila, Wennappuwa D/S Division, Puttalam District - Cad. Map No. 410001
categorisation: This gazette content deals exclusively with land title registration matters under the Registration of Title Act. It contains declarations of determination for specific land parcels (including parcel numbers, extents, owner details, and encumbrances) in various villages. The content appears in "PART III - LANDS" of the gazette and focuses on property ownership registration, which falls squarely under the Land Gazettes category (Type 4) for land and property-related matters.
